explainer_content.short_definition: The early-2000s 'rock is back' lane: lean guitars, vintage attitude, and controlled rawness.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Garage revival made small, sharp guitar bands feel urgent again after nu-metal, post-grunge, and electronic gloss dominated the edges of rock culture.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It reset indie-rock style for the 2000s and gave guitar minimalism a new mass memory.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The signal is deliberate reduction: fewer parts, cooler surfaces, tighter riffs, and retro electricity.
